name: Ousmane Sonko
detail: Prime Minister and Pastef leader. His 2025 tax reform (money-transfer, gambling and tobacco taxes, influencers, a revised income tax scale) is about income and consumption; no statement for a tax on wealth found.

name: Pastef
detail: Governing party (130 of 165 seats). Searches for its programme found no impôt sur la fortune. Its asset-declaration bills concern officials' disclosure, not a tax.

name: Forum Civil (Birahim Seck)
detail: Tax justice work on mining tax settlements and tobacco excise; no call for a tax on wealth found.

name: Mamadou Lamine Diallo
detail: Economist and Tekki leader; spoke of confronting the financial oligarchy, no wealth tax statement found.

name: Afrobarometer 2021 (taxes in Senegal)
detail: Survey: 79% say a higher tax rate for the rich is fair. It asks about rates on the rich, not about a wealth tax, so it is not recorded as a poll.
